message: You know, I've always believed that being a little over-prepared is just a sign of good sense. With storm season upon us, it’s a great time to brush up on how to handle hurricanes. I found a resource that breaks it down nicely—because why wait until the wind starts howling? It’s reassuring to have a plan in place, even if I’m the only one in the family with an emergency snack stash. 🍪
